title: Aerospace corporations hold UAP knowledge shielded from FOIA

tellings.quote: aerospace corporations have knowledge in the uap area that specifically are sequestered by against foia because of proprietary appreciables which the whole thing was set up to be that way

plain: Aerospace companies hold knowledge about UAP, the official term for UFOs, and that knowledge is shielded from FOIA, a US law that lets anyone request government records, because it counts as the companies' private property. That is what the physicist Hal Puthoff says in a debate with Eric Weinstein on the show, adding that the whole arrangement was set up to work that way. If true, it would explain why public records requests turn up so little.
